| MORTGAGE | 17,024.79 | 0.125888 | 15,370.37 | 0.129953 | +10.76% | -3.13% |

- **int_rate**: 0.129953

arguments.query:
WITH portfolio_benchmarks AS (
  SELECT 
    AVG(funded_amnt) AS port_avg_funded,
    AVG(int_rate) AS port_avg_int_rate
  FROM loans_fact
),
home_ownership_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    h.home_ownership,
    AVG(l.funded_amnt) AS avg_funded_amnt,
    AVG(l.int_rate) AS avg_int_rate
  FROM loans_fact l
  JOIN home_ownership_dim h ON l.home_ownership_id = h.home_ownership_id
  GROUP BY h.home_ownership
)
SELECT 
  ho.home_ownership,
  ho.avg_funded_amnt,
  ho.avg_int_rate,
  pb.port_avg_funded AS benchmark_funded_amnt,
  pb.port_avg_int_rate AS benchmark_int_rate,
  (ho.avg_funded_amnt - pb.port_avg_funded) / pb.port_avg_funded * 100 AS funded_amnt_vs_benchmark_pct,
  (pb.port_avg_int_rate - ho.avg_int_rate) / pb.port_avg_int_rate * 100 AS int_rate_vs_benchmark_pct
FROM home_ownership_stats ho
CROSS JOIN portfolio_benchmarks pb
WHERE ho.avg_funded_amnt > pb.port_avg_funded
  AND ho.avg_int_rate < pb.port_avg_int_rate
ORDER BY ho.avg_funded_amnt DESC;
